Huawei P9 Launched in India for Rs. 39,990

The Chinese mobile company aka Huawei has launched another Android smartphone in India. Although it was initially launched in April in the home country but now after almost four months, they have finally launched Huawei P9 in India. Considering the price, this is a high-end smartphone that can be comparable with some smartphones such as LG G5, Samsung Galaxy S7 Edge and more. However, as this is a Chinese company, people will certainly hesitate before opting for this mobile which has such a high price tag. Let’s check out the specifications and a brief review of this mobile to know whether you should buy this phone or not.

Huawei P9: Specifications, Features and Price in India

The design of Huawei P9 is superb, and it looks premium holding on hand. It comes with a complete metal body with the metallic finish that makes the smartphone right regarding build quality. Huawei has launched this smartphone in plenty of color variants including Ceramic White, Haze Gold, Rose Gold, Titanium Grey, Mystic Silver, and Prestige Gold. The dimension of this mobile is 145 x 70.9 x 7 mm and it weighs 144gms only. The weight is significantly lighter than what it should and considering the material used to build this mobile.

Talking about the network availability, you will get 4G LTE support along with 2G and 3G data connectivity. It has dual SIM facility, but it comes with hybrid SIM slot. That means you can use either 2 SIM cards or 1 SIM card and one microSD card.

The display of this mobile is not bad, and the viewing angle is much better. You will get 5.2-inch IPS-NEO LCD capacitive touchscreen with 1080 x 1920 pixel of screen resolution. The pixel density is 423PPI, which is sufficient for doing almost all kind of things. Huawei P9 has Emotion UI 4.1, which is the native interface of Huawei. You will get some useful features, and plenty of stuff can be done while having this UI.

Talking about the performance, this mobile should provide a good performance as you will get HiSilicon Kirin 955 chipset, which is the personal motherboard company of Huawei. This chipset would be available in Huawei P9 and P9 Plus, which is still under development. With this mobile, you will get Octa-core processor in which you will get 4×2.5 GHz Cortex-A72 and 4×1.8 GHz Cortex-A53. Apart from that, you will get Mali-T880 GPU, which is a newly launched GPU and it performs pretty well.

In this mobile, you can find 4GB RAM with 64GB internal storage. However, according to some reviewers, this mobile has 4GB of RAM with 32GB of internal storage. You can extend your storage up to 256GB using microSD card.

Huawei P9 has a good camera. You can find two rear cameras in this mobile that will spruce up your image quality. You can find pictures as you seen with naked eyes. This is where Huawei P9 excels. You will get 12MP rear camera with F/2.2 aperture, 27mm lens, dual LED flash, Leica optics, smile detection, panorama, HDR and more other regular features. It has HD video recording option. You can record video at 30FPS as well as 60FPS, and the video quality would be 1080p. Not only that, the front side has 8MP camera, what can capture pretty good photos and record 1080p videos.

It has a fingerprint sensor, which is pretty much common nowadays. However, some additional features will make it productive. Apart from that, you can get the Type-c port, and it has fast charging facility. Your phone can charge from 0% to 100% in 2hours.

The battery quality would be excellent as it has Li-Ion 3000 mAh battery that cannot be taken out from the phone.

Huawei has set a price of Rs. 39,990. However, some sources reported that the price is Rs. 39,999.
